messages:
Rae (Security): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: partner onboarding for SOC2/ISO. We promised a short, actionable checklist.

Arjun (CTO): Agree. Keep it simple: VPC connectivity, KMS/BYOK, audit log exports, and artifact list for auditors.

Lena (Compliance): Minimal artifacts: architecture diagram, control owners, sample access review, key-rotation proof, and signed shared-control attestation. Also note ISO needs crypto algorithm + key lifecycle notes.

Ivy (Infra): For audit logs we can provide daily JSONL exports to partner buckets. Filename pattern: partners/<id>/audit-YYYYMMDD.jsonl. Each line: ts, req_id, principal, action, resource, success.

Kai (DevRel): I'll draft the partner README with steps for requesting BYOK and a verification command. ETA: 7 business days.

Rae (Security): Action items: Kai - README/checklist due 2024-10-25; Ivy - log export schema + manifest due 2024-10-20; Arjun/Product - BYOK acceptance criteria due 2024-10-18; Lena - artifact checklist due 2024-10-22. Confirm? :thumbsup:

Arjun (CTO): Confirmed. Suggest pilot with one partner to validate end-to-end.

ops-bot: "Partner Evidence Office Hours" created weekly starting 2024-10-09, invites sent.

Rae (Security): I'll post the draft doc at go/internal/partner-onboard and tag owners when ready. Thanks all!
